comparison_A2_5.comparison_set: disruption subclass only. permanent_closure rows are EXCLUDED from the headline and reported separately; they are not disruptions and the estimand is duration-given-damage.
comparison_A2_5.verdict: ARCHITECTURE.md's central claim does NOT survive. Completability is determined by PERMANENCE, not by cause.
comparison_A2_5.finding:
A2.1 registered that this block must be able to falsify the document that commissioned it. It does, and the mechanism turns out to be cleaner than either side of the original argument.

DISRUPTIONS COMPLETE AT THE SAME LOW RATE WHOEVER CAUSES THEM. Attack-caused: 8 COMPLETE of 75 (10.7%), field rate 37.3%. Accident-caused: 1 of 19 (5.3%), field rate 31.6%. There is no meaningful gap, and on the field rate the accident class is LOWER.

PERMANENT LOSSES COMPLETE AT 100%. The permanent_closure subclass is 80 of 80 COMPLETE — every row, from a single already-retrieved EIA table. The difference between 5% and 100% is not cause and not belligerents. It is that a permanent loss has a determinate duration BECAUSE THERE IS NO RESTORATION, and a temporary outage does not, because no reporting regime records when capacity came back.

THE PER-FIELD SPLIT LOCATES IT EXACTLY. Across the two disruption classes the asset is identified at similar rates (72.0% attack, 79.0% accident) and capacity_nameplate at similar rates (26.7% vs 15.8%). The collapse is in the two fields that define vulnerability: capacity_affected 17.3% vs 5.3%, and days_to_full_restore 20.0% vs 5.3%. Those are the fields ARCHITECTURE.md attributes to belligerents contesting them — and they are missing at the same rate in a class with no belligerent in it.

THE STRONGEST SINGLE PIECE OF EVIDENCE: the CSB report on the 2015 ExxonMobil Torrance explosion. 73 pages, a federal investigation, retrieved in full, no belligerent anywhere near it — and it contains neither the refinery's capacity nor the date the unit came back. Thirteen CSB refinery investigations were retrieved and NOT ONE carries a capacity or a restoration date.

WHAT SURVIVES of the five reasons. CATEGORY MISMATCH survives and is strengthened: hurricanes fail asset identification 0 of 4, exactly as campaign-type attacks did in block A, so the mismatch belongs to the schema and the event's geometry. CLOSED ARCHIVES survives but is not conflict-specific — the closed archives here are the US federal government's own. CONTESTED FIELDS, INCOMPATIBLE UNITS and FORECAST-NOT-CONFIRMED RESTORATION do not survive: they cannot explain missing durations in a class with no belligerent, where the durations are missing at the same or a higher rate.

THE CLAIM TO REWRITE IT TO: restoration duration is recorded only where restoration never happens. The 6% is real and it measures the absence of any reporting regime — statutory or otherwise — that records how much capacity a specific incident removed and when it came back. Conflict has nothing to do with it.
comparison_A2_5.why_permanent_closures_are_reported_sepa: They are not disruptions and they are excluded from the headline. Pooling them would take the accident COMPLETE rate from ~5%% to ~85%% and manufacture overwhelming apparent support for the claim under test, which A2.1 forbids. They are included in the file, flagged in_comparison:false, because at n=80 they are the cleanest available demonstration of the mechanism: the same six fields, the same standard, 100%% completion — and the only difference is that the loss is permanent.
comparison_A2_5.limitation_restated: Amendment 1 §A1.4: the accident set is US assets under EIA and CSB mandates and the attack set is not, so any residual gap is cause confounded with reporting regime. The disruption comparison is 75 against 19.

declined_expansion.what_was_available: EIA Refinery Capacity Report Table 13, 'Refineries Permanently Shutdown By PAD District Between January 1, 1990 and January 1, 2026', retrieved in full. It gives, for roughly fifty US refineries: name, location, Total Atmospheric Distillation Capacity (bbl/cd), Date of Last Operation and Date Shutdown.
declined_expansion.why_it_would_have_completed: Every one of those rows could have been filled to 6/6 at this standard: asset_name and asset_type from the table, capacity_nameplate from the table, capacity_affected equal to it because the refinery ceased operating entirely, and both duration fields 'never' because the shutdown is permanent. That is roughly FIFTY additional COMPLETE rows from one already-retrieved document.
declined_expansion.why_it_was_declined: They are not outage events. A refinery that shut permanently for commercial reasons is not a disruption, and the study's estimand is duration-given-damage. Including them would have taken the accident class's COMPLETE rate from 1-in-11 to about 50-in-61 and produced overwhelming apparent support for the very claim this block was registered to TEST. That is the one outcome the design forbids: A2.1 registered that the block must be able to falsify the document that commissioned it, and manufacturing its confirmation from a different phenomenon would defeat the exercise. The route is recorded so the decision is visible and reversible by Joe rather than invisible.
declined_expansion.what_it_does_show: The completable accident outages are exactly the permanent ones. PES completes for the same reason: the duration fields are determinate because the answer is 'never'. Restoration duration is recoverable when there is no restoration.
